arms.crop_join: One ASCII space between text.split() tokens
arms.single_changed_factor: Allocation of a fixed original-ID sample weight between original text and its prefix crop.
arms.weights: Eligible original 0.9 plus its crop 0.1; ineligible original 1.0. Each original ID has total weight exactly 1.

clean_length_subgroups.boundaries: Whitespace-word-count tertiles learned on original 8000 fitting texts; digitize right=True; merge no bins after scoring.

calibrated_development_gate.implementation: Calibrator receives original rows only. Base estimator.fit fits features on its current fitting originals, then creates weighted crops internally. Never augment before splitting calibration originals.
calibrated_development_gate.on_failure_or_insufficient_evidence: Keep WC120. No export, new crop weights, ensembling or retrospective changes to gates.
calibrated_development_gate.run_only_after: All remaining structural/class-support grouping checks and the unchanged random/topic/sealed-condition performance gates pass.

data_boundaries.grouping_text_scope: Reuse the exact parent original-8000 grouping, frozen blind reviews and original topic-fold assignment; no grouping refit. Predictive features remain strictly fitting-fold originals only.

evaluation_conditions.digit_runs_to_zero: Python Unicode re.sub(r'\d+', '0', text), all held IDs.
evaluation_conditions.middle_100: 100 whitespace words beginning at floor((n_words-100)/2), same IDs as prefix.
evaluation_conditions.missing_condition_policy: Record insufficient evidence or not evaluated due to declared stopping; never count missing/undefined AUC as passing.
evaluation_conditions.paired_unit: Original document ID, including all variants and both model arms.
evaluation_conditions.prefix_100: First 100 whitespace words, original n_words >=150 only.
evaluation_conditions.quote_and_dash: Existing q5_sensitivity quote_typography mapping followed by dash_typography, all held IDs.
evaluation_conditions.reveal_new_conditions_when: After both random and topic primary gates pass; score cached fold models without additional fitting.
evaluation_conditions.suffix_100: Last 100 whitespace words, same original n_words >=150 IDs as prefix.
evaluation_conditions.whitespace_only: One ASCII space joining text.split(), all held IDs; no tokens removed.

execution.checkpointing: Immutable run directory; atomic per-stage/per-fold receipts and hashes; resume only identical incomplete steps.
execution.fit_warning_policy: ConvergenceWarning invalidates the fit; no silent parameter increase or favorable-score-only partial result.

export.external_check: Coordinate current team slots before any separately authorized upload. Do not infer quota/reset times from the old Sunday workflow. Record actual score without retuning this protocol.
export.schema: id,label; label is P(AI=1), exact original 3000 test IDs

hypothesis_status: Adaptive continuation authorized after observing prior stopping diagnostics and fallback-random results; not a fresh preregistered confirmation.

implementation_check_reuse.policy: Reuse unchanged estimator/metric regression results; run only zero-fit checks for revision split handling and soft-vs-hard constraints.

out_of_scope_this_round: reusing the prior fallback split as a size-matched control

predictive_representation.fit_scope: Original documents in the current fitting boundary only; no crop text enters vocabulary or IDF fitting.
predictive_representation.forbidden_cv_shortcut: Do not load the saved all-8000-row transformer for any cross-validation fold.
predictive_representation.raw_cv_sharing: Fit one representation per fitting fold; use identical transformed originals/crops for both classifier arms.

purpose: Continue the fixed weak-crop comparison with the exact prior topic proxy and folds; treat the two challenged engineering thresholds as diagnostics, with exact-count matched random controls.
required_checks_before_real_fit: synthetic baseline wrapper/direct-pipeline equivalence; full real-data reproduction occurs only in stage 3
no held-original ID or variant enters feature fitting
calibration originals and their variants stay within fitting boundaries
matched class/total fold counts and topic disjointness
deterministic paired condition IDs and undefined-AUC handling

revision.interpretation: Lexical-topic/style proxy only; subgroup sensitivity reported, no true domain/generator claim.
unchanged: all performance and calibrated development gates
revision.user_authorized_change: Convert content-topic count >=9 and held-fold upper size <=3334 from hard promotion conditions to transparent diagnostics.

screening_gates.failure_action: Finish the already started stage and save all its fold results; do not start later stages, alter hyperparameters or export. A mechanical failure may resume the identical unfinished protocol.

sealed_conditions_after_primary_pass.claim: Passing a non-regression floor does not establish improvement on those conditions.

sensitivity_analysis.classification_source: Frozen combined decisions in parent topic_review.json; every non-content topic is mixed_and_style.
sensitivity_analysis.prediction_source: The identical held topic-model primary and, if opened, suffix/middle predictions; no new model fits and no deletion of fitting groups.
sensitivity_analysis.promotion_role: Secondary only; cannot rescue or veto unchanged primary performance gates.
sensitivity_analysis.undefined_policy: Keep empty/single-class rows as None. Descriptive defined-fold means report contributing fold counts; no cross-fold margin pooling.

stages_and_svc_fit_budget.accounting: New-study maximum24 SVC fits:6 exact-count matched random +6 prior-topic folds +8 calibrated development +4 eligible full refit. No grouping refit. Prior six fallback fits and prior seven synthetic test fits remain historical and are not counted as newly run fits.
stages_and_svc_fit_budget.fit_budget_scope: Competition-data SVC fits only; no additional real-data baseline fit is allowed outside these stages. Full baseline reproduction is part of the budgeted stage 3.

interval_limitations: Overlapping training folds are not independent replications
Suffix/middle variants are not independent datasets
Multiple conditions are not independent tests
statistics.invalid_replicate_policy_all_schemes: Skip single-class/undefined replicates, report valid counts, never redraw to obtain a desired number of valid samples. An interval is unavailable below 90 percent valid replicates; a gate requiring that interval becomes insufficient evidence. Descriptive-only intervals do not themselves determine promotion.
statistics.primary_cv_summary: Equal-weight mean of the three within-fold arm AUROC differences, with all fold AUROCs/differences and ranges.
statistics.random_bootstrap: Within each held fold, class-stratified paired original-ID resampling; reuse each draw across arms and conditions; recompute macro fold difference. Eligibility subsets use the sampled eligible IDs.
statistics.reused_validation_bootstrap: Class-stratified paired original-ID resampling, reuse across arms and conditions; 95 percent percentile intervals for clean and prefix differences.
statistics.topic_bootstrap: Resample whole topic clusters with replacement separately within each fixed held fold, preserving all document variants and arms; report valid replicate count, discard single-class replicates, do not redraw until 1000 valid. Descriptive conditional sensitivity only with 12 groups.

topic_proxy.interpretation: Adaptive reuse of fixed lexical-topic/style proxy; content count and size imbalance are diagnostics, not true source/generator evidence.
topic_proxy.matched_random_control: Use exact prior topic fold memberships; class-wise permutation seed545 allocates the exact held fold human/AI counts. Original fallback random seed546 is historical and not reused as the new matched control.
topic_proxy.on_invalid_grouping: Only the two named historical checks are diagnostic. Any remaining structural/class-support hard-check failure stops this revision without altering clustering, reviews or assignments.

quality_gates.review: Before labels/scores are revealed to reviewers, inspect 12 top unigram terms and 5 seeded local documents per cluster. Record IDs, topic description and content/mixed/style-format decision, not passages. Two independent reviews; disagreement counts as mixed.
